records.plant_name: Amazon Web Services Canton Data Center power station

verifications.note: Mississippi air permit 1720-00098 for Amazon Data Services in Canton, issued 2024-12-04 and modified 2025-12-16. It lists each generator with its kW rating.

Saved copy of the Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality facility page for the Canton site, taken December 2, 2024. It shows the permit file start date of 01/18/2024 and air construction permit 1720-00098 in public comment.

Measured AI newsletter on Amazon's Mississippi data centers. Citing the Madison County Economic Development Authority, it says Amazon broke ground on the Canton campus in May 2024 and had foundation work under way on four of the five Phase I buildings by July 31, 2024, and that five buildings were operating by summer 2025.
Mississippi Today article of June 9, 2026. An Amazon spokesperson says five buildings are operating at the Canton site.

records.note: The Mississippi air permit for the Canton site lists 10 smaller generators that GEM does not carry. Five house generators are 750 kilowatts each, two water treatment generators are 1,500 kilowatts each, and three building generators are 400, 400 and 250 kilowatts. Together they are 7.8 megawatts. The permit lists them in addition to the 326 large generators that GEM already has as Unit 1. Ridgeland and Meridian already show their small generators as a separate unit, so this follows the same pattern. Construction of the Canton campus started in May 2024, and foundation work was under way on four of the five first buildings by July 31, 2024, according to the Measured AI newsletter citing the county economic development authority. Amazon told Mississippi Today in June 2026 that five buildings are operating at the site. These generators serve that campus, so the status is construction. No report says when these particular generators were installed.
records.researcher_notes: Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality air permit 1720-00098 for Amazon Data Services at Canton lists HEG 1-5, permit units AB-001 to AB-005, the 1,112 horsepower Caterpillar C18 engines for 750 kW generators. Each is printed with the engine horsepower and the generator kilowatt rating. The generator kilowatts are lower than the engine horsepower converted to kilowatts, so the printed kilowatts are electrical output and not shaft power. These house generators add to 3.75 MW. The permit was issued December 4, 2024 and modified December 16, 2025. Construction of the Canton campus started in May 2024, and foundation work was under way on four of the five first buildings by July 31, 2024, according to the Measured AI newsletter citing the county economic development authority. Amazon told Mississippi Today in June 2026 that five buildings are operating at the site. These generators serve that campus, so the status is construction. No report says when these particular generators were installed. The permit application date comes from the state facility page, not the permit.
records.action: Add unit 2 to the Canton plant as 5 diesel internal combustion engines of 0.75 MW each, 3.75 MW in all, status construction, Backup Power yes, captive power for a data center. These are HEG 1-5, permit units AB-001 to AB-005. Milestone timeline: add a pre-construction milestone for January 2024, when the air construction permit application was received, with the saved copy of the Mississippi facility record as the source. Then add a construction milestone for July 2024, when foundation work was under way on the campus, with the Measured AI newsletter as the source. Add the Measured AI newsletter and the Mississippi Today article of June 9, 2026 to the Status Data Source box.

milestones.note: The Mississippi Department of Environmental Quality facility page for the Canton site shows the permit file started January 18, 2024. Air construction permit 1720-00098 was issued December 4, 2024 and modified December 16, 2025. It covers all 336 engines, including these 10 smaller ones.
milestones.period_note: The permit does not print the application date. The date is the start date on the state facility page.

milestones.note: Amazon broke ground on the Canton campus in May 2024. Foundation work was under way on four of the five first buildings by July 31, 2024. Five buildings were operating by summer 2025, and Amazon confirmed five operating buildings in June 2026.
milestones.period_note: No source gives a start date for these particular generators. The date is the earliest report of work under way on the campus they serve. The May 2024 groundbreaking is not used because a groundbreaking alone is not construction.
